name: Unisem (M) Berhad
summary: Unisem (M) Berhad, together with its subsidiaries, provides semiconductor assembly and test services for electronic companies in Asia, Europe, and the United States. The company offers packaging and leadframe packaging services including advanced integrated circuit packaging technology, such as wafer bump, redistribution layer design and fabrication, flip chip interconnect, and wafer level chip scale packaging, as well as a range of leadframe and substrate integrated circuit packages.
